_about: One model for every number (Hanli, 2026-10-15; design.md § Pacing and the economy). The rules read these through content.mjs (withBalance) — the 层 thresholds onto the ladder, the pay tables onto rewards, the cooldowns onto the 饭桶 and 兽潮 — and tools/balance.mjs simulates a light, a typical and a heavy player on them, day by day, printing days per 回; tests/balance.test.mjs holds the bands. Change a number here, run `node tools/balance.mjs`, and hand-play it on the live page.
_master: 数值系统 phase 2 (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「数值系统继续做吧」; design.md § 数值系统): the knobs. Everything this table derives — `layers`, `play_pay`'s hours · games · errand · wall · chore · seclusion, `pills`, the `pill` and `seclusion` pay caps, `convert.rate`, a 修为 pill's and gear's `buy` and every `sell` — is written by `node tools/numbers.mjs --apply --write` (a dry-run diff without --write), never by hand; a number that must not follow its formula is an `overrides` row. tests/numbers.test.mjs holds the dry run empty. Every 修为 pay is a share of the layer (play_pay), so `need` is the numbers he reads, not the pace: the pace is `hours`, the shares, the model's minutes and the book's length. A line is a ladder of its own (Hanli 10-27: 古 · 今 · 未来 each their own 修为 and realms): `lines.gu` is built; 今 and 未来 get their rows, with their own pace, when their pay is.

gu._about: 古's ladder (ladder.json tiers: 练气 九层 from 零层, three steps a realm above). `need`: 练气一层 470, ×1.1 a layer, ×1.3 into the next realm, so 筑基小成 is above 练气九层 and every step above the one below. `hours`: the games' rate — a layer's play hours. `chore`: 人间功课 is 古-line income (Hanli 10-27: 「算古线吧」), a day's 10% and a week's 20% of the layer (Hanli 「按照百分比奖励」). `wall.day`: a day's posted 杂役 tags together (执事堂's east wall, quests/wall.json), as a share of the layer — about a day's 功课; each tag is it over the wall's `posts` (Hanli 10-27: three a day at the full errand rate were half a layer of short fetch-and-deliver chores). `seclusion.night`: a night's 闭关 (rest_hours) as a share of the layer (ruling a: it was 40 × layer_pay, ~23% at 四层) — the idle fallback, and the yardstick 「抵N日打坐」 is checked against. `pills`: a 修为 pill's share by 转 (一转 half a night, 三转 a night and a half, 九转 three nights: the cards' 「抵半日」 · 「抵三日」 hold at every layer); `below`: past its 阶, a quarter a realm.

hours._qi: The curve (练气一层 2 h, +0.5 h a layer) with one point pinned, a decision, not a fit: 二层 0.772 h (2026-10-27, 古四's 柴房 fix: a dearer 二层 would land on a save already at the 秘境 door, option D). 七·八·九层 were pinned at 1.256 · 1.382 · 1.507 h from 古七's fix until 古八's own (2026-10-28, doc/gates-2026-10-27.md 古八 (a + c)): its years' gates are in `fit.gates` now and the fit prices them.

fit._floor: Hanli 2026-10-28 (decided): no layer under about 0.6 h of play — at 0.3 h one 5-minute board was half of 三层.

jin._about: 今's ladder (ladder.json `lines.jin`: 新生 九层 from 一层, three steps a realm above; Hanli 2026-10-27, each line its own 修为, starting from zero). Its only 修为 is its boards (no fights, errands, 功课, 闭关 or pills on 今 yet; 人间功课 pays 古): `games` carries the whole layer (`share` 1) over about half its minutes (`time`, the rest is reading). `need`: 新生一层 300, the same steps as 古's (display only: pay is a share of the layer). `hours`: the curve (新生一层 1 h, +0.25 h a layer), then fitted (`fit`, tools/master.mjs fitLine) so a reader of 卷一 who plays every 今 board at `stars` ends `end` layers up: 1.4 is 新生一层 filled and 二层 four tenths (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「今线修为可以开始做了」, the interludes about 一层 → 二层).

difficulty._about: The fight bands the bot (tools/story-fights.mjs, lookahead) is held to: a story fight's first meeting bare, a pool's beast; `slack` the deals' noise before a fight is red. A fight may name its own band (story-fights FIGHTS `band`).

economy._about: `income`: 灵石 a minute of play, the typical player's from 三层 on (tools/numbers.mjs `ls_min`, ~3.0–3.3). A 修为 pill costs `pill_minutes` of income for each 1% of a layer it gives (聚气丹, 5%: 80, its price before the table); gear `gear_minutes` of income a point (攻 · 防 · 抗) by kind; a shop buys back `sell_back` of its price (a third), where it buys back at all. `convert`: 灵石 per 修为 past the mark, read at 练气一层 (playpay.mjs convertRate) — the same 灵石 at every layer.

mijing._about: 秘境探险 (rules/mijing.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-28): the run's knobs, derived into `mijing` (tools/master.mjs mijingOf). `key`: a 秘境令's chance on a win in each cooldown event (兽潮 `shouchao` — a night, so about one a day; 比武切磋 `qiecuo`; 妖兽出没 `yaoshou`, a pool's beast won) under `cap_day` a day, so a day holds at most that many runs. `pay`: a run's 修为 is its minutes of rooms cleared at the games' rate (play_pay: the same per minute as any board, so a run never runs ahead of the pace) × `rate` (0.12 since 2026-10-28: a 练气 layer is about an hour of play, so a full-rate run was half a layer and the day's two a whole one — the run pays mostly in loot and 灵石; a day's two runs are about a tenth of a 练气 layer); a run not cleared pays `short` of it, and keeps its loot by the depth reached (`keep_min` at least). `hurt`: a board room's 气血 cost by its stars (a share of the run's), `yield` leaving one unplayed. `foe_step` · `td_step`: a 重 deeper, the foes' 气血 and the TD levels' difficulty. `wealth`: 灵石 in minutes of the typical income (economy.income) — a room won `room`, a chest `chest`, a clear `clear` — each 重 deeper `step` more. `clear.items`: the pills a clear pays (by 重, `from` · `to`); an arm and the 大妖's card come from the drop table and the beast.

_overrides: Numbers that do not follow their formula, each with its reason; --apply lays them on last and the 数值 page lists them.

overrides.why: 妖丹 are the beasts' trade goods: a shop buys them back at two thirds (a beast's drops sell on them).
妖丹: two thirds, as 一阶.
妖丹: two thirds, as 一阶.

_layers: The progress each step asks, by tier (ladder.json names the steps). 练气 counts from 零层 (0). Derived from the master table since 2026-10-27 (master.lines.gu.need: 练气一层 470, ×1.1 a layer, ×1.3 into the next realm; node tools/numbers.mjs --apply) — display only: every pay is a share of the layer. Before: fitted by balance.mjs --fit (retired).
_overflow_stretch: Hanli, 2026-10-15 (approved): a step up — the story's rise, a throw, or grinding the 回's cap allows — carries the 修为 over the last mark in whole, and the new step asks this share of it more (state.mjs stepUp, `state.stretch`): 100 over 一层's mark enters 二层 at 100/450, not 0/400. Grinders stay only somewhat ahead; nothing is held or lost.
_pay: What each kind of thing pays at most (修为 `progress`, 灵石 `wealth`); a grant is capped by its table (rules/core.mjs pay). Was rewards.json `tables`. Hanli, 2026-10-15 (「让游戏修为和故事match」): 修为 comes from cultivation; chores pay 灵石. `labor` pays an errand of 杂役 (修为 0, design.md § Pacing), `gongke` the day's 功课 (the fixed real-life chore, 修为 20), `life` the day's pick (灵石 only), `once` 开府 (灵石 only). A natural day of 卷一 play is now ~138 修为 (功课 20, two pool fights 60, half a rumor ~38, a road-meet 20) and the 练气 thresholds ask a 回 of it per held layer (tools/xiuwei-model.mjs). The 2026-09-24 note below is history. 2026-10-16 (灵石 buys pills, and cards and gear after): a fight won at a haunt pays 15 灵石 (was 10); 功课 stays 修为 — a typical day ~49 in, ~36 to pills, a few hundred left at 卷一's end (tools/balance.mjs --wealth). 2026-10-22 (人间功课 as cultivation, worlds/jiuding/gongke.json): `chore_kind` caps what a chore's meaning adds on top of its own pay, `chore_week` the 宗门月俸. 2026-10-27: `gongke` and `life` pay a share of the layer (play_pay.chore: a day's 10%, a week's 20%) — their `progress` here is no cap any more; `haunt` pays its minutes of play (play_pay.fight), the rest as authored, read against 练气一层 (play_pay.authored).
_pay_stage: `stage` pays a 阶段任务 handed in (rules/gates.mjs stageTurn, Hanli 2026-10-16: 「七层圆满的任务大成了应该可以交任务拿奖励」). At 圆满 the 修为 cannot rise, so it pays 灵石: 60, three scenes' pay (`scene` 20) — about three days of the 回's 杂役 and 开府 — once per gate, never again; a gate crossed before stage quests paid is settled once on the next load (settleStages).
_convert: 圆满之后走剧情到下一个阶段; 刷副本或者打怪奖励的修为改为灵石 (Hanli, 2026-10-15). A grant on one of `tables` (a pool's or a haunt's fight — never a scene, a board, the 功课, a rumor or a road-meet) pays 修为 only up to the full mark of the layer he may not step past (the 回's cap, or a realm's peak waiting on its cauldron); the rest is paid as 灵石 at `rate` per 修为 (rules/core.mjs pay), and never carries into the next layer. Default 1/3: a converted fight (30 修为 → 10, with its own 10 灵石) pays about one 杂役 errand (labor 20). The economy (tools/balance.mjs) owns the number.
_kailu: 开炉's worth (rules/fantong-roll.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-27: 扔草药出丹, 扔物品出装备, 其他出符): what a thing is worth to the 饭桶 — its shop `sell` (prices below), else its 品阶's `tier` (fantong.json `tiers`); a 灵石 fed is worth `lingshi`. The grade rolled asks for an output worth the pot's worth × `x`, at least `floor` — 凡 a little under what went in, 有用 about it, 珍品 and 逆天 well over — so a pot of junk always gives something, a pot of good things gives about their worth back and the bucket is no farm. A row's chance falls off with how far its worth stands from that (log scale, `spread`), and nothing past `reach` times either way is drawn. `band`: what tools/numbers.mjs holds a pot's average return to (what comes out ÷ what went in) for the families' sample pots.
_prices: Every shop price, one source (2026-10-16, Hanli: 灵石 buys pills): `buy` what a shop asks, `sell` what it gives back — folded onto items.json by content.mjs withBalance, so no item carries its own. 回春丹 15 and 回气丹 10: a typical day's 灵石 (tools/balance.mjs `--wealth`) buys two or three, and a pill eaten in a fight is gone.
_boards: Hanli 2026-10-16: a small game after 入门 pays 灵石 on its first clear only — plain 5, good 10, best (or all three 灵光) 15; a replay pays nothing. Before 入门 nothing is paid (state.mjs lockedOf shuts wealth). The rank: a task's `ranks` names it outright; else three stars is best, and of the listed marks the first (the clean clear) is best, the last plain, one between good; a board with no marks (洛书门, 小周天, the 今 boards) pays plain — a reading, not Hanli's word, to change here. On top of the task's own grant (rules/tasks.mjs boardPay).
_cooldowns: (The pools of 后山 · 上山路 are 妖兽出没's since 2026-10-28: they come in batches, `events.yaoshou`, never by these two.) `pool_rest_min`: a pool rests that long before the next beast stands — only after `pool_rest_after` wins in a row (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「后山的怪可以加多谢么? 或者做成打不完的」: never after every fight; a pool may say its own `rest` and `rest_after`; world.mjs poolResting). A beast beaten again the same day pays play_pay.replay's falling share. `fantong_min`: after a feed the 饭桶 is full that long (rules/fantong.mjs). `shouchao_h`: 兽潮 comes again that many hours after the last night counted, at any hour (rules/shouchao.mjs; 2026-10-26, replacing the 酉时 window; an hour since 2026-10-28, Hanli: 「兽潮好玩」 · 「改成1小时一次也行」 — the day's pay held by `play_pay.tide`).
_qiecuo_h: 切磋's cooldown (rules/qiecuo.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-28: 「冷却3小时」): a bout comes again that many hours after the last was over — won, lost or put down.
_events: 冷却事件 (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「按你说的来」; rules/events.mjs): exactly three, each on a fun 主力 game — 兽潮 (塔防, rules/shouchao.mjs), 比武切磋 (格斗, after 宗门大比), 妖兽出没 (斗法). Shared: the cooldown `every_h` runs from completion (won, lost or skipped); a waiting event waits and never stacks; announced once (the tray or the 主页), never nudged; the day's first `full` pay in full, then play_pay.replay's falling share (the third half, the rest a tenth). `yaoshou` (rules/yaoshou.mjs; replacing `pool_rest_*` at these pools): the pools of 后山 · 上山路 (`pools`) hold a batch of `batch` fights; each fight settled there takes one, the last completes it; `yaoshou skip` lets a batch go (the clock starts, the day's count of batches paid in full does not move). A fight's pay keeps the beast's own replay share (play_pay.replay by beast) and is multiplied by the batch's. `title`, `open`, `shut`: the world's words for it.

open.zh: 后山和上山路一带，又有妖兽出没了。
open.en: Beasts are abroad again on the back hill and the mountain road.

shut.zh: 山里的妖兽才被打退，一时不敢再下来。
shut.en: The beasts were only just driven back; they will not come down again for a while.

_pills: 丹药 in the game (design.md § 丹药; story DESIGN § 六·五): every pill is `tier` (its 阶) and `zhuan` (一至九转) on items.json; a pill that pays 修为 names its family `of` (one of `families`), and content.mjs withBalance folds its effect onto the `pill` table: `share` by 转 × play_pay.authored.base — so eaten it pays that share of the layer he stands on, at every layer (一转 5% · 三转 15% · 九转 30%: 半日 · 一日半 · 三日 of 闭关), `below` a realm past its 阶. Derived from the master table (master.lines.gu.pills; 数值系统 phase 2, 2026-10-27 — Hanli: 「聚气丹修为+20, 3转才加30? 不太对吧」: they had borrowed the puzzle · task · scene tables). Breakthrough pills (ladder.json breakthrough.pill.items) declare no `of`: the throw reads them by 转; fight pills keep `effect.fight` (the 丹囊 bands).
_dandu: 丹毒 and 补转 (story DESIGN § 六·五: 下品吃多了积毒，体力上限一时降低，闭关可排；上品无毒；九转反能化毒). A 修为 pill eaten (服用 from the pouch, the 闭关 pill, a breakthrough's pill) leaves the turns its furnace left out owing: `owed` by 转 (一转 8 — the nine a 九转 has, less the one it got; 中品 四至六转 看体质, none in 卷一; 上品 none). Each turn owed takes `per_turn` off the 体力 pool's top, `cap` at most (state.mjs staminaMax). 闭关 is 补转 — the body makes up `cure_per_hour` turns an hour of any focus (rules/seclusion.mjs). A pill of `clears` 转 or more clears every turn owed. Fight pills (the 丹囊's 回春丹 · 回气丹) owe nothing for now (Hanli's call: 灵石 buys them, and 丹毒 there would tax the 灵石 once 体力 is on). With these numbers a 聚气丹 a day is made up by one hour's sitting; four at once stand at the cap until a night's 闭关.
_model: The players tools/balance.mjs plays, day by day (design.md § Pacing: ~30 minutes a day, one 回 a week; 古一–古三 fast). `minutes`: what each thing takes (a scene's passages read at `chars_per_min`). `players`: minutes a day (the first day longer), sittings, and what each does daily — `gongke` the share of days the 功课 is handed in, `walls` the share of a day's 执事堂 east-wall tags taken in the routine (2026-10-27, doc/gates-2026-10-27.md: the typical player one of the three; every player takes the rest while a gate holds him), `fights` pool fights, `fantong` feeds, `tale` 今日传闻s, `gate_fights` more pool fights while a stage quest waits, `seclude` hours of 闭关 a night (focus 修为: rewards.json seclusion's rate, the seclusion table's cap). `fight_win_rate`: a fight won (the 斗法 band, played again when lost). `fantong_progress`: a feed's 修为 on average (a pill now and then). `errands_at`: the 回 each errand that pays 修为 or a pill is done in (null: on no 卷一 map; tests/balance.test.mjs makes a new one name its 回). `fit`: the player and the days --fit aims the stage quests at (the heavy player: the one they hold back); `bands`: what the test holds, for the 回s from `later` on. Guesses to be hand-played on the live page (Hanli). `waking_h`: the waking day the sittings spread over, for 体力 — the model plays it ON (rewards.json stamina), as players will have it; while we test it is off (rules.mjs), and with these players it never binds.

model._practice: 2026-10-27 (pay as a share of the layer): while a stage quest holds the way, the minutes left after the pool's fights go to practice boards — `minutes` a board, `factor` for its ★ (≈0.8) and the replay's falling share over a sitting (≈0.75).
model._session: 2026-10-27 (Hanli at 古五's 渡口, 129/498: 「渡口前应该让玩家接近2层圆满」): the playtest player — the book straight through in long sittings, no nights between, no 功课, no 闭关, no wall tags but while a gate holds him (balance.mjs playWalls). The gate rule (master hours.fit `arrive`) holds the 修为 a one-layer gate asks to be about earned by the time he reaches it; never in the bands.
model._story_stars: The story's own boards, played on the way: each pays its play pay (its minutes at the layer, rules/playpay.mjs) at this ★ (2 = 0.8), on top of its task's grant (数值系统 phase 2: they had been counted for their grant alone).

bands._except: Since 2026-10-16 the story raises no layer: every 层 is ground. With `layer_pay` (修为 by the layer) every 回 from 古四 sits in the one typical band, 5–7.5 days — save 古五 (h07), allowed down to 4.5: the smooth curve keeps 二层 cheap so 古六's two layers fit (see `_layer_pay`). Lowered to 4 on 2026-10-16: the boards cut before 入门 (Hanli 「减少数量, 推动剧情」) shorten the opening, and 古五 lands 4.3 typical days. 2026-10-26: with the book's full text, 古四 (h05) reads 7.7 typical days and 古六 (h08) 10.1 — allowed to 8 and 10.5 until the new small games land and the 层 are re-fit (fit._hold). 2026-10-26 (全文后的小游戏 第二批): 古六's nine new boards add their minutes to the light player (19 → 22 days); its light band allowed to 24, its typical to 11, its heavy to 6.5 while fit._hold keeps 古四–古六 at 470…530. 第八回 (h09)'s three boards (考书 · 用哪颗丹 · 恬惔虚无) lift its typical 7.1 → 7.8, and 今四's six (it rides with 古八) to 8.1: allowed to 8.5, the same hold. 2026-10-27 (pay as a share of the layer, play_pay): a fight won pays its minutes of play (练气四层 ≈ 12, was 30 × layer_pay 3 = 90), so this model — which plays fights, 闭关, the 功课 and, held at a stage quest, practice boards (`practice`) — runs 古六–古八 long (typical 13 · 10.1 · 12.6 days); the bands are widened to what it prints until the 层 are re-fit or the practice share is played in full (doc/games.md § Pay as a share of the layer). 2026-10-27 (数值系统 phase 2): the hours are fitted to the bands (master.lines.gu.hours.fit), so 古六–古八 (h08 · h11 · h09) are back in the one band and their widenings are gone; 古五's light player reads 7.9 days with the rerun run only while it raises him — its light band from 7.5. 古七 (h11) reads 4.5 typical days on the curve's 五–六层 (4 · 4.5 h): dearer layers would stretch it into 5–7.5 only by keeping him at 09-futian's gate (Hanli 10-27: no gate may keep him where there is little to do) — allowed from 4 until its book is longer.

model._pills: 灵石 out (2026-10-16): the pills a player carries into a fight and eats — `pills` per fight a player, bought at the mean shelf price of `pills_bought`, only with what he has (tools/balance.mjs --wealth prints the flow).

_play_pay: Every 修为 pay is a share of the layer he stands on (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「12分钟的一个小游戏占2个小时的10%, 所以要奖励10%的修为」, then 「一层才要470修为, 我们可否按照百分比奖励, 这样等级高了后, 奖励也合理」; doc/games.md § Pay as a share of the layer; rules/playpay.mjs). A layer is a play-time budget (`hours`, derived since 2026-10-27: the master table's curve — 练气一层 2 h, +0.5 h a layer; 筑基 4 h, +2 h a realm — with the layers a 回 holds fitted to its band and 古五's 渡口 to the gate rule, master.mjs fitHours). The small games and fights carry `games.share` (60%) of its 修为 over `games.time` (35%) of its minutes: a board of m minutes pays m ÷ (0.35 × the layer's minutes) × 60% of the layer's need — 练气一层 a 1-minute board 1.4% (7), a 6-minute 棋牌 8.6% (40) at 2 h; a fight won (`haunt`) its `fight.minutes`. ★ 0.6 · 0.8 · 1.0; the same board again the same day 100 · 50 · 10%. Errands: 15% of the layer over 10% of its time, by `errand.minutes` (练气一层 6.3%, 29). 人间功课 (`chore`): a day's 10%, a week's 20%, a month's 30% of the layer (练气一层 47 · 94 · 141; Hanli 2026-10-27: 「cfo倒入账单应该是每月任务」 — rarer, so more), no ★, no replay. What the book authors — a scene's way on, a pill, a rumor, a 机缘, the tables in `authored.tables` — is read as a share of the 练气一层 it was written against (`authored.base` 470: a scene's 60 is 12.8%). 灵石 stays by the kind and the tables. No daily cap; 修为 stops at the gate and turns to 灵石 (`convert` lists `play` and `haunt`). Supersedes the per-layer `rate` tables and `layer_pay` for fights (2026-10-27).

play_pay._qiecuo: 切磋 (rules/qiecuo.mjs): a bout won pays `share` of the layer he stands on × ★; the day's first `full` bouts in full, the later ones `replay`'s falling share. 灵石 as a 格斗 board (`wealth`).
play_pay._tide: 兽潮 every hour (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「改成1小时一次也行」) is no farm: a day's first `full` nights pay in full, the later ones `replay`'s falling share (the third half, the rest a tenth) — rules/shouchao.mjs tideShare.
play_pay._skip: 跳过 · 酬减半 (Hanli 2026-10-27, 晒经's 华容道: 「让用户能跳过去, 就好了」): a board an errand needs, left once stuck, counts for the errand — met and paid in full — and pays this share of the board's own play pay at full ★ (rules/tasks.mjs errandSkip). The page's button says the cut from this number.
